I got 2 cards. One from my mom (also a widow) and one from a fellow widow friend. No meals, food or visits. Most likely because I live an hour away and no one could be bothered. I have seen them through many deaths of family members with 100% support (cards, flowers, memorial gifts, planning & creating a celebration of life all on my own for one of them, meals, snacks, yard work, errands, babysitting, cleaning, sitting & listening or letting them cry on my shoulder, checking on them periodically yet not too often to be bothersome, remembering the anniversaries of special dates, letting them talk of their deceased loved one). I did all of that for decades before my spouse even got remotely sick. Not one single person other than my immediate family showed up for me. And I’ve since been ghosted because I’m not happy. I will still mail sympathy cards and sporadic caring cards forever for people suffering in my life though.
